Let θ be the angle of inclination of the inclined plane.

KE = initial total mechanical energy − PE

− W against friction

tb-206-24.question:
Two blocks X and Y, which are initially at rest on a smooth horizontal surface, are pulled by the same horizontal force F provided by motors. X has a larger mass than Y. The motor pulling each block stops after each block has moved by the same displacement s.

tb-206-24.answer:

(b) The two blocks have the same final KE and X has a larger mass than Y. 1A

By KE =mv2, the final speed of X is lower than that of Y. 1A
